name: idle_hero_r2__t8_lean_rest

spec._doc: Gesture spec for the processional hero idle at 144 px, round R2 (tools/art-construct/figure_r2.py). Starts from idle_hero_r1 (weight on the far leg, hand on the far hip, glaive leaning away) and changes: the R2 painted head (Confident, 1 px roll), fuller thighs, calves and hips, painted hands, and a near arm that rests down-and-out on the staff instead of reaching out level (thumbnail round below). Units as the C1/R1 specs: h = px above the sole, dx = px from the body centre at the feet (+ = the facing side). Every number is [I] until the learning log (ART-RULES 10, round R2) records it.
spec.name: idle_hero_r2__t8_lean_rest

zones._doc: polygons in dx/h (the checker converts). keep_out: nothing of the named kind may be inside. must_be: the named thing must be there.

keep_out.name: between the eyes below the lash

spec._tilt_doc: tilt_deg = angle of the near->far line; + = the far (screen-right) side higher. Weight on the far leg: far hip up (+), shoulders the other way (-).

thumbnails.name: t1_r1arm
thumbnails.idea: control: the R1 near arm (glaive 17 deg, grip 98 px up the haft: the hand level with the shoulder and the arm at full reach, the flag-holder read) with the R2 masses and head
thumbnails.verdict: KEPT as #2 (the control, 11/11): the R1 arm, hand level with the shoulder at 44.7 px from it, the bell hanging off a level forearm (the flag-holder read by eye)

thumbnails.name: t2_rest_low
thumbnails.idea: the near arm rests down and out on the staff (grip 84 px up, glaive 16 deg, butt 2 px nearer): the arm becomes a diagonal from the shoulder, the bell hangs from a falling forearm
thumbnails.verdict: dropped (#4, 10/11): the lower grip reads relaxed but the haft passes 2 px from the near boot (GR-P10)

thumbnails.name: t3_rest_mid
thumbnails.idea: between R1 and t2: grip 92 px up at 18 deg, butt 4 px nearer

thumbnails.name: t4_lean
thumbnails.idea: the upper body leans toward the staff (pit of the neck and head 3 px toward it) so the near shoulder comes to the grip and the elbow can bend; the weight heel moves under the new plumb line
thumbnails.verdict: dropped (#6, 10/11): the full 3 px lean moved the weight heel and tipped the weight leg to 6 deg (FG-P10); t7 is the same idea at two-thirds strength

thumbnails.name: t5_rest_push
thumbnails.idea: t3 plus one step more contrapposto (FG-N09): shoulders -9, hips +9, free heel lifted 2 px more
thumbnails.verdict: dropped (#7, 9/11): the extra tilt bent the free knee to 36 deg and read as a sway (the R1 t4 finding again)

thumbnails.name: t6_control
thumbnails.idea: negative control: level shoulders and hips, both knees straight, glaive 6 deg (the round-4 mannequin); must score last
thumbnails.verdict: negative control, last as it must be (4/11): level axes, locked knees, a 6 deg staff

thumbnails.name: t7_lean_soft
thumbnails.idea: t4 with half the lean (pit and head 2 px toward the staff) and the weight heel kept under the far hip, so FG-P10 holds
thumbnails.verdict: KEPT, HERO (#1, 11/11, gap 361 px2): the chest and head lean 2 px toward the staff and the neck sets 2 px further back, so the near shoulder comes closer to the grip (reach 42.8 px, elbow 124 deg against R1's 134) and the head tilts off the neck (FG-P12); she leans on her staff instead of holding it out, and the plumb line still lands on the weight heel

thumbnails.name: t8_lean_rest
thumbnails.idea: t7 plus t2: the soft lean and the lower grip (glaive 16 deg, grip 84 px up, butt 1 px further out than t2 for GR-P10)
thumbnails.verdict: dropped (#3, 10/11): the lean plus the low grip; the haft runs 3 px from the near boot (GR-P10, a tangent), and at 2x the arm hangs so low that the bell covers the near thigh

_decisions: round R1 (2026-09-29): six thumbnails built with the final R1 part models and scored on 11 silhouette rules; t2_hiphand (#1) and t5_hip_haft24 (#2) kept; the hero is t2. The collar hand DESIGN 1 names fails FG-N04 once the bell sleeves are at DESIGN size (the drape closes the window and covers the chest window); that is listed for Dex in DESIGN 13 and logged in ART-RULES 10 (R1).
spec._thumb_doc: every thumbnail set is written against the R1 body (r1_body) so the round reproduces after the hero (t7) was folded into the base; the base also carries neck.back 6 (the head-neck angle, FG-P12)

log: gesture: joints from targets by IK; weight on the far foot
mannequin: rib cage and pelvis boxes on one spine; limbs as tapered cylinders
r1: dressed at DESIGN sizes (bell sleeves, hime back hair, veil), painted r1 head; one key light from the upper front (the facing side); outline and contact lines as C1
r2: R2 painted head (back hair under the chin left to the body layer); calf offset and deltoid masses; paint passes r2_veil, r2_torso, r2_gloss, r2_legs, r2_thighs, r2_hairtail, r2_tabard, r2_hands
_doc: the spec this sprite was built from (tools/art-construct/figure_r2.py, round R2) and the log
